attempts.message: traceroute 실행 실패: context deadline exceeded

findings.title: Traceroute attempts timed out
findings.summary: One or more traceroute attempts did not complete within their execution deadline.

findings.title: No completed traceroute attempt reached the destination
findings.summary: The destination was not observed as reached in any completed traceroute attempt.

actions.title: Repeat the timed-out trace
actions.step: Repeat the bounded trace from the same vantage point.
actions.expected_result: Every attempt completes before its deadline.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate if bounded attempts repeatedly time out after runtime availability is verified.

actions.title: Verify the route from the same vantage point
actions.step: Repeat the bounded trace and compare the last responsive hop and destination reachability.
actions.expected_result: At least one completed trace reaches the destination or identifies a stable last responsive hop.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate with the recorded hops if repeated completed traces still do not reach the destination.
